main.description: Proposal to authorize an actual force operation. Goes through 1 SBT = 1 vote with 50% quorum + 67% supermajority. Normal voting: 72h; emergency: 24h (requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 emergency attestation). Per ADR-2605192315 §3.

proportionalityAnalysis.description: Analysis of proportionality vs threat. Religious accountability standard.

thirdPartyReviewCid.description: Optional independent legal / ethical review reference.

rdPublicationsReferenced.description: AT URIs of force-rd-publication records relevant to this authorization.

actorDids.description: DIDs of Adherents who will perform the force operation.

emergencyDeclared.description: If true, requests 24h emergency voting (requires concurrent Council Lv6+ ≥3 emergency attestation).

councilEmergencyAttestationUris.description: Required if emergencyDeclared. AT URIs of Council emergency attestations (≥3).
